strings.PDF de standards.nasa.gov (88 páginas) e: PDF from standards.nasa.gov (88 pages) as text: cover and change log, foreword, the record requirements of §4.2.1 and §4.3.6, and Appendix E up to the presentation of the results factors (E.1 to E.3.4 and E.4.1, tables 5, 6 and 12); of the level tables, table 7 and the start of table 8. On 2026-10-26, the introduction of §4.1 and §4.1.1 (page 20) and the whole of Appendix D (pages 56 to 61: D.1 to D.3 with tables 3 and 4; figure 1, only through the labels that come out when it is converted to text).
strings.Portada, registro de cambios y prólogo (: Cover, change log and foreword (pages 1 to 3 of 157): it is the handbook for revision A.
strings.Credibilidad de cada capa que predice o: Credibility of each layer that predicts or infers
strings.NASA-STD-7009B, la norma de modelos y si: NASA-STD-7009B, NASA's standard for models and simulations, asks for the credibility of a model to be recorded by factors and conveyed to whoever decides. The team's knowledge base (§2.3) asks every new predictive layer to state its credibility and uncertainty. Here, for each figure that EMMA labels INFERRED or PREDICTED, is what there is under each factor of the standard, said as it is.
strings.NASA-STD-7009B pide registrar la critici: NASA-STD-7009B asks for the criticality of each use of a model to be recorded ([M&S 6]), and its Appendix D proposes a matrix that crosses two axes: the consequence of the decision and the influence the model results have on it. Here, for each layer, is what there is on each axis, said in words.
strings.Y el método con que se evaluó: And the method used to assess it
strings.Los cortes de cada fila se fijan con esa: The breakpoints of each row are set with that authority
strings.La influencia depende de la otra informa: Influence depends on the other information
strings.Como guía de buenas prácticas, para cual: As a guide for best practices, for any model
strings.Capacidad del modelo (lo que sale del de: Model capability (what comes out of development)
strings.Resultados del modelo (lo que sale del u: Model results (what comes out of use)
strings.EMMA no ha evaluado ninguna capa con las: EMMA has not assessed any layer with the level tables of the standard (7 to 11 and 15 to 20): no cell carries a level or a score, and what each one says is what there is, not how much it is worth. Factors are not added up or compared either: the standard asks not to combine them.
strings.Cada cifra INFERIDA o PREDICHA tiene aqu: Each INFERRED or PREDICTED figure has its sheet here, with the eleven factors and what there is on the two criticality axes of Appendix D. The test requires every function that labels a figure this way to have a sheet, and every sheet to name a function that labels. No layer has validation against a referent.
strings.Observaciones que llegan ya rotuladas IN: Observations that arrive already labelled INFERRED or PREDICTED by ingestion (POST /api/observations with their `model_version`): the model belongs to whoever sends it, and EMMA only requires that it be named.
strings.El simulador: sus series se rotulan por: The simulator: its series are labelled by environment («simulated»), not as INFERRED or PREDICTED; the backing of each drift is in /api/status, `simulation.evidence`.
strings.El borrador de interpretación (`app/inte: The interpretation draft (`app/interpret/`, Class C): it is not a figure and does not enter the analysis.
strings.Una guía NASA-HDBK-7009 para la revisión: A NASA-HDBK-7009 handbook for revision B: searched for on standards.nasa.gov on 2026-10-23 and not found; the one published there, NASA-HDBK-7009A (2019), is the one for revision A, which assessed capability and results together.
strings.Las tablas de nivel de cada factor, salv: The level tables of each factor, except table 7 and the start of table 8: they have not been applied to any layer.
strings.Las fuentes de las que el Apéndice D tom: The sources from which Appendix D takes its consequence categories: those categories were searched for on 2026-10-31 in the NASA Systems Engineering Handbook (NASA/SP-2016-6105 Rev 2) and in the NASA Risk Management Handbook, which is the same NASA/SP-2011-3422 and not a separate document. Neither carries the scale of Table 3: in the first the labels of the ends of the scale do not appear, and in the second the label of the upper end appears only once and not as a level. They were searched by keyword, not read in full. The procedure NESC-PR-006 was not found: NTRS returns no results, and it is not public in what was searched. Where each cell of Table 3 comes from is still not known.
strings.EMMA no ha aplicado la matriz del Apéndi: EMMA has not applied the Appendix D matrix to any layer, nor has it recorded the criticality of any ([M&S 6]): the standard places that determination in the hands of program or project management with the delegated NASA Technical Authority, and nobody with that authority has made it. Each sheet says which decision the figure informs and what other information there is when it is taken, not which cell of the matrix it falls in.
strings.Proyección de las derivas al horizonte d: Projection of drifts to the relevance horizon
strings.Dosis de misión y de carrera proyectadas: Mission and career dose projected to the end of the mission
strings.Horquilla de la dosis proyectada por tip: Range of the projected dose by radiation type
strings.Banda de pérdida de densidad mineral óse: Band of bone mineral density loss
strings.Dosis acumulada facilitada (la que lee e: Supplied cumulative dose (the one the risk reads)
strings.Dosis equivalente estimada de la dosimet: Estimated dose equivalent from ISS dosimetry
strings.No hay datos de desarrollo: el modelo es: There are no development data: the model is a least-squares line over each crew member's readings in the trend window, with no parameters fitted on another data set.
strings.El único dato de desarrollo es el factor: The only development datum is the mean quality factor of the flight, measured with a TEPC on Spacelab SLS-1 (1991, low Earth orbit; registry card `badhwar-1992-sls1-tepc`, read in its PubMed abstract). It is applied outside the environment in which it was measured.
strings.Ningún dato de desarrollo propio. El lím: No development data of its own. The career limit is that of NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4030], which was read.
strings.El factor de calidad medio del vuelo, me: The mean quality factor of the flight, measured with a TEPC on Spacelab SLS-1 (1991, low Earth orbit; registry card `badhwar-1992-sls1-tepc`). It is applied outside the environment in which it was measured.
strings.Los factores de calidad de la radiación: The quality factors of trapped radiation and of galactic cosmic rays, measured with a TEPC on Spacelab SLS-1 (1991, low Earth orbit; registry card `badhwar-1992-sls1-tepc`), with their uncertainty on the card.
strings.La tasa de pérdida de población sin cont: The population loss rate without countermeasures published by NASA («The Human Body in Space», registry card `nasa-human-body-in-space`), classed as a documented magnitude. It is not a model of this person.
strings.No hay modelo de EMMA ni datos de desarr: There is no EMMA model and there are no development data.
strings.Los factores de calidad medios medidos c: The mean quality factors measured with a TEPC on Spacelab SLS-1 (registry card `badhwar-1992-sls1-tepc`). The Q(L) function of ICRP 60 is written, but OSDR RadLab does not publish the spectrum it needs.
strings.Pruebas unitarias sobre series construid: Unit tests on constructed series: a real drift is projected with its model and its margin, noise is not projected, a constant drift falls within its margin and one that stops is flagged as a miss (list of tests on the sheet). There is no estimate of the numerical error and no end-to-end verification against error requirements.
strings.Pruebas unitarias de la integral por tra: Unit tests of the trapezoidal integral with the factor applied, and that a single reading gives no dose (list of tests on the sheet).
strings.Pruebas unitarias: sin dosis previa decl: Unit tests: without a declared prior dose, zero is not assumed; the profile reaches the scale; and without a positive limit there is no fraction (list of tests on the sheet).
strings.Pruebas unitarias: la tasa media se prol: Unit tests: the mean rate is extended to the configured end, after the end there is nothing to project, the career figure requires a declared prior dose, the days before the first reading are stated and not extrapolated, and the projection does not feed the cumulative dose or any level (list of tests on the sheet).
strings.Pruebas unitarias: la horquilla usa los: Unit tests: the range uses the two SLS-1 factors, is labelled INFERRED, and each factor names the card it cites (list of tests on the sheet).
strings.Pruebas unitarias: la banda crece con el: Unit tests: the band grows with the mission day, in postflight it stops at the return day, and it does not change with the measured exercise (list of tests on the sheet).
strings.Pruebas de la ruta: la cifra se rotula I: Route tests: the figure is labelled INFERRED, at the limit the domain reaches EMMA's highest level, and a dose recorded in the ledger reaches the limit (list of tests on the sheet).
strings.Pruebas unitarias: la dosis equivalente: Unit tests: the measured dose equivalent is preferred over the estimated one, without it the factor is applied, the integral runs over the real gaps and the figure declares its provenance (list of tests on the sheet).
strings.Ninguna frente a un referente. «¿Acertar: None against a referent. «Were the projections right?» compares each projection with what was measured when its horizon arrived, in retrospect and with signed snapshots: it is a calibration of the model itself on each crew member's data, which in the demonstration are simulated. MMASH, 24 hours on Earth, does not cover a horizon of weeks.
strings.Ninguna de esta integral frente a un dos: None of this integral against a reference dosimeter. The closest thing is a test marked `live`, outside the default suite, which integrates a real day of DosTel with the same factor in `environment/dosimetry.py` and checks that it falls within the documented ISS range: an order-of-magnitude comparison, from another module.
strings.Ninguna: ninguna proyección se ha contra: None: no projection has been compared with the dose recorded at the end of a mission.
strings.Ninguna: la densidad ósea no se mide a b: None: bone density is not measured on board, and the band has not been compared with densitometry before and after any flight.
strings.No hay modelo de EMMA que validar: la ci: There is no EMMA model to validate: the figure is calculated by whoever records it, and EMMA neither has that model nor has compared it with anything.
strings.Un contraste de orden de magnitud, no un: An order-of-magnitude comparison, not a validation: a test marked `live`, outside the default suite, integrates the real DosTel series of 2022-04-01 and checks that with the mean factor it falls within the documented ISS range and with Q = 1 below it. It has not been compared with a dose-equivalent dosimeter.
strings.Ninguna revisión técnica formal ni indep: No formal or independent technical review. Changes go through the code review of the development itself, which is not the peer review of the standard.
strings.Control de versiones local con un cambio: Local version control with one change per commit, ruff and mypy --strict passing, and mutant campaigns on the defences. There is no model life-cycle plan ([M&S 41]) and no record of permissible uses ([M&S 14]) other than this sheet.
Local version control with one change per commit, ruff and mypy --strict passing, and mutant campaigns on the defences.
strings.Uso: mostrar a dónde llegaría una deriva: Use: to show where a real drift would get to if it went on the same, labelled PREDICTED and with the basis «it is not a clinical prognosis». The figure and its margin are only shown; the engine decides whether a drift is of concern with the same slope and the same horizon, against the relevance threshold and with its standard error. That fitness for use has not been assessed with the table of the standard.
strings.Uso: mostrar la dosis equivalente de est: Use: to show the dose equivalent of this mission, labelled INFERRED, and to add it to the declared prior dose on the career scale. It does not enter the cumulative dose of the risk or any level. That fitness for use has not been assessed with the table of the standard.
strings.Uso: mostrar la fracción del límite de c: Use: to show the fraction of the career limit the crew member would reach with this mission. It does not feed the radiation level, which reads the supplied cumulative dose (sheet `supplied-cumulative-dose`). That fitness for use has not been assessed with the table of the standard.
strings.Uso: mostrar la dosis de esta misión y l: Use: to show the dose of this mission and the career dose at the configured end of the mission, because the rationale of [V1 4030] counts the projected exposure of the mission in the career. It is shown and does not feed the cumulative dose of the risk or any level (there is a test). That fitness for use has not been assessed with the table of the standard.
strings.Uso: enseñar cuánto sería la dosis proye: Use: to show how much the projected dose would be if all of it were of one type or all of the other. It is not a confidence interval, and it says so. It does not enter any level. That fitness for use has not been assessed with the table of the standard.
strings.Uso: mostrar la trayectoria inferida, no: Use: to show the inferred, not measured, trajectory that the specification asks for (§9). It does not add to any state or raise an alert (there is a test). That fitness for use has not been assessed with the table of the standard.
strings.Es la única de estas cifras que entra en: It is the only one of these figures that enters the risk: the radiation level compares it with the career limit. That fitness for use has not been assessed with the table of the standard.
strings.Uso: estimar la dosis equivalente de una: Use: to estimate the dose equivalent of a window of real ISS dosimetry. The answer warns that it is not an operational-grade dosimetric result, and the figure does not enter the state of any crew member. That fitness for use has not been assessed with the table of the standard.
strings.Las lecturas del registro firmado del tr: The readings in the crew member's signed ledger within the trend window, each with its declared type and environment; in the demonstration, those of the deterministic simulator.
strings.La tasa de dosis absorbida registrada en: The absorbed dose rate recorded in the signed ledger since the start of the mission; in the demonstration, that of the simulator.
strings.La dosis previa la declara el perfil fir: The prior dose is declared by the crew member's signed profile; EMMA does not check it against a dosimetric record. The mission dose is that of sheet `mission-dose`.
strings.La tasa media registrada desde la primer: The mean rate recorded since the first reading and the configured mission duration; the days before the first reading are not extrapolated, and the basis says how many they are.
strings.La dosis absorbida proyectada (ficha `mi: The projected absorbed dose (sheet `mission-dose-projection`). EMMA does not know the mix of radiation types of the mission: OSDR RadLab gives no spectrum.
strings.Solo el día de misión y la fase, del cal: Only the mission day and the phase, from the configured calendar. The recorded exercise is shown alongside and does not adjust it.
strings.El parámetro de la consulta o la última: The query parameter or the last cumulative-dose observation signed in the ledger; the answer says which of the two. Where the recorded dose is calculated has no source (cost of measuring, pending).
strings.Series de tasa de dosis absorbida de OSD: Absorbed dose rate series from OSDR RadLab, through its cached client, with the age of the data and its expiry; the dose-equivalent field exists in the schema and is not populated.
strings.Margen de la pendiente: su error típico: Margin of the slope: its standard error times the t threshold of significance, carried to the horizon. It does not include the uncertainty of the linear assumption or that of each reading.
strings.No se propaga ninguna: la cifra sale sin: None is propagated: the figure comes without an interval. The mean factor carries no uncertainty on its card and the mix of radiation types of the mission is unknown.
strings.Ninguna propagada; la dosis de misión qu: None propagated; the mission dose it adds does not carry one either.
strings.Ninguna propagada. Supone tasa constante: None propagated. It assumes a constant rate: it does not foresee solar events, and the mean includes a past event if there was one; its basis says so.
strings.La incertidumbre de cada factor está en: The uncertainty of each factor is on its card and is not propagated to the range.
strings.La banda, de la tasa baja a la alta, es: The band, from the low rate to the high one, is the spread given by the source. It does not include the variation between people or the effect of exercise, whose magnitude cannot be cited.
strings.Ninguna: la observación no trae interval: None: the observation carries no interval.
strings.No se propaga; el factor elegido viaja c: It is not propagated; the chosen factor travels with the figure.
strings.Sin análisis de sensibilidad a la ventan: No sensitivity analysis to the window, the horizon or the significance threshold. Only a drift that can be told apart from noise is projected.
strings.Sin análisis de sensibilidad. La horquil: No sensitivity analysis. The range by radiation type, another layer, shows how much the projected dose varies with the quality factor.
strings.Sin análisis de sensibilidad a la tasa n: No sensitivity analysis to the rate or to the duration.
strings.La horquilla es en sí una variación de u: The range is in itself a variation of one input, the quality factor, between two measured values; there is no other sensitivity analysis.
strings.Sin análisis de sensibilidad del nivel a: No sensitivity analysis of the level to this figure.
strings.Se puede pedir con otro factor de calida: It can be requested with another quality factor, and a test pins that Q = 1 underestimates the dose by the mean factor; there is no other analysis.
strings.Ninguna revisión técnica de los resultad: No technical review of the results in use; each figure is shown with its basis and its model.
No technical review of the results in use; the figure is shown with its basis and its model.
No technical review of the results in use; the figure is shown with its basis.
No technical review of the results in use; the figure is shown with its basis and its source.
No technical review of the results in use; the band is shown with its basis and its source.
No technical review of the results in use.
strings.Se recalcula en cada consulta. Una vez a: It is recalculated on every query. Once a day the projection is signed in the ledger as a snapshot and is compared when its horizon arrives.
strings.Se recalcula en cada consulta y no se gu: It is recalculated on every query and is not stored; it carries its `model_version`.
It is recalculated on every query and is not stored.
It is recalculated on every query and is not stored. Unlike the drift projection, no snapshot is signed and it is not compared at the end of the mission.
strings.Se recalcula con la proyección en cada c: It is recalculated with the projection on every query and is not stored.
strings.Se recalcula en cada consulta y no se es: It is recalculated on every query and is not written to the ledger as a measurement.
strings.Cada observación entra por el registro f: Each observation enters through the signed ledger; the query parameter is not stored.
strings.Se calcula en cada consulta desde la cac: It is calculated on every query from the RadLab cache and is not stored.
strings.La cifra proyectada solo se muestra, rot: The projected figure is only shown, labelled PREDICTED. The same slope, compared with the relevance threshold at the same horizon, adds to the state of the domain and can end in an alert, which the crew and the ground read; a person decides. The decision it informs is about the health of a crew member; what consequence a mistake would have has not been classified.
strings.Se muestra, rotulada INFERIDA, y se suma: It is shown, labelled INFERRED, and is added to the declared prior dose on the career scale; it does not enter the cumulative dose of the risk or any level or alert. What it informs is decided by whoever reads it, about the exposure of a crew member.
strings.Se muestra como fracción del límite de c: It is shown as a fraction of the career limit of NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4030]; it does not feed the radiation level, which reads the supplied cumulative dose. What it informs is decided by whoever reads it.
strings.Se muestran la dosis de esta misión y la: The dose of this mission and the career dose at the configured end of the mission are shown; they do not feed the cumulative dose of the risk or any level (there is a test). What they inform is decided by whoever reads them.
strings.Se muestra como horquilla de la dosis pr: It is shown as a range of the projected dose; it is not a confidence interval and does not enter any level.
strings.Se muestra como trayectoria inferida del: It is shown as the inferred trajectory of the bone domain; it does not add to any state or raise an alert (there is a test). What it informs is decided by whoever reads it.
strings.Es la única de estas cifras que entra en: It is the only one of these figures that enters the risk: the radiation level compares it with the career limit, and on reaching it the radiation domain moves by itself to EMMA's highest alert level. The decision it informs is about the exposure of a crew member, and a person takes it.
strings.Estima la dosis equivalente de una venta: It estimates the dose equivalent of a window of real ISS dosimetry; it does not enter the state of any crew member or any level, and the answer warns that it is not an operational-grade dosimetric result.
strings.Junto a la proyección están las lecturas: Alongside the projection are the measured readings it comes from, with their series, their personal baseline and the deviation of each one from it. There is no other model and there are no flight data of that person to compare it with beforehand: «Were the projections right?» compares it afterwards with what was measured.
strings.Junto a ella están la tasa de dosis regi: Alongside it are the recorded dose rate it comes from and the solar events EMMA receives. On board Orion the warning of a radiation event is given by HERA, which EMMA does not read. EMMA has no other model of the mission dose to compare it with.
strings.Junto a ella están la dosis previa decla: Alongside it are the prior dose declared in the crew member's signed profile and the mission dose it adds. EMMA does not have the career dosimetric record to check the prior dose against.
strings.Junto a ella están la dosis de misión ya: Alongside it are the mission dose already accumulated and the recorded rate it comes from. It assumes a constant rate and does not foresee solar events; EMMA has no other model of the mission dose to compare it with.
strings.Junto a ella están la dosis proyectada q: Alongside it are the projected dose it splits and the two quality factors, each with its card. EMMA does not know the mix of radiation types of the mission.
strings.La densidad ósea no se mide a bordo: jun: Bone density is not measured on board: alongside the band there are only the mission day and the recorded exercise, which is shown alongside and does not adjust it. The band has not been compared with densitometry.
strings.EMMA no tiene el modelo de esta cifra: l: EMMA does not have the model of this figure: it is given by a query parameter or by the last cumulative-dose observation in the ledger. Alongside it are the recorded dose rate and the solar events EMMA receives; the HERA warning, on board Orion, is not read by EMMA.
strings.Junto a ella está la serie de tasa de do: Alongside it is the absorbed dose rate series from OSDR RadLab it comes from; the measured dose equivalent is preferred when the series carries it, and today that field is not populated.
strings.Sin `model_version` propio: suma la dosi: No `model_version` of its own: it adds the prior dose declared in the profile and the inferred mission dose (sheet `mission-dose`).
strings.Sin `model_version` propio: es la dosis: No `model_version` of its own: it is the absorbed dose of the projection (sheet `mission-dose-projection`) times the two quality factors by type.
strings.EMMA no la calcula: la da un parámetro d: EMMA does not calculate it: it is given by a query parameter or by the last cumulative-dose observation in the ledger. It is labelled INFERRED because effective dose is a calculated quantity, not the direct reading of a sensor.
strings.Sin `model_version`: la respuesta nombra: No `model_version`: the answer names the quality factor applied (`model`) and its source, and declares whether the dose equivalent is measured or estimated.
